- Test: `TestMatrix_AxisSouth` in package `example.test/matrix/matrix`

This strongly indicates `AxisSouth` is defined in the **`matrix`** package, most likely in a file such as `matrix/matrix.go` (with its test counterpart in `matrix/matrix_test.go`). Unfortunately, the repo/tests/git/episodes handles available to me don't expose a file-read or grep verb to pinpoint the exact filename beyond the package path `example.test/matrix/matrix`, so I can't give a more precise file path than the `matrix` package directory within the repository.
